# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines next test increment for TDD loop |
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop with planning |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Executes one complete RED→GREEN→REFACTOR cycle |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for Python; generates & executes code |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code via LLM for each phase |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution in container |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Manages rootless Podman container lifecycle |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses .feature files into FeatureSpec |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Blocks forbidden imports in generated code |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Runs TDD across multiple language pods |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook CRUD, persistence, delta updates |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Retrieves relevant bullets via keyword & embedding |
| BulletDeduplicator | src/playbook/deduplication.py | Removes semantically duplicate bullets |
| BulletClusterer | src/playbook/clustering.py | DBSCAN clustering of playbook bullets |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router.py | Routes queries to domain-specific playbook context |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes LLM tasks with playbook context |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes insights into playbook delta bullets |
| EnsembleLearner | src/ensemble/learner.py | Orchestrates multi-model learning & voting |
| ConsensusBuilder | src/ensemble/consensus.py | Builds consensus from multiple model proposals |
| VotingSystem | src/ensemble/voting.py | Applies voting strategies to bullet approval |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD cycles & ML experiments to DB (PostgreSQL/SQLite) |
| PlaybookRepository | src/storage/repository.py | PostgreSQL repository with pgvector for bullets |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified interface for multiple LLM providers |
| EmbeddingService | src/utils/embedding.py | Local embedding generation for semantic search |
| ContextMap | src/utils/context_map.py | Builds AST signature context for code generation |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on performance |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Extracts metrics from audit trail |
| CapabilityRegistry | src/broker/capability_registry.py | Tracks anonymous agent capabilities |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src/analytics/token_efficiency.py | Computes token efficiency scores across runs |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src/analytics/success_rate_calculator.py | Measures experiment success rates |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main as main()
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Bridge as GherkinFeatureBridge
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    Main->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    Runner->>Bridge: parse(feature_path)
    Bridge-->>Runner: FeatureSpec
    loop over cycles (max_iterations)
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle
        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(test_files)
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult (failed)
        Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
        deactivate Pod
        alt GREEN retries
            loop max_green_attempts
                Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error)
                Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
                deactivate Pod
                opt green passed
                    break
                end
                Cycle->>Cycle: error_feedback = green_output
            end
        end
        Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
        deactivate Pod
        Cycle->>Playbook: get_bullets(section)
        Playbook-->>Cycle: bullets
        Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        alt learning enabled
            Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
            Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
            Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
            Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
            Cycle->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
            Playbook-->>Cycle: added_bullets
        end
        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
        deactivate Cycle
        Runner->>Runner: check complete
    end
    Runner-->>Main: IterativeResult
```
